sermons.title: Sermon 2086 | Taking Possession Of Our Inheritance

scripture.verse: "Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, you and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel. Everyplace that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses."
"Now we have received, not the spirit of the world but the spirit which is of God, that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God."

sermons.title: Sermon 2088 | The Form of Godliness Without the Power

scripture.verse: "Having a form of godliness but denying the power thereof: from such turn away."
"For unto us was the Gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it."
"For we which have believed do enter into rest, as He said, As I have sworn in My wrath, if they shall enter into My rest."
"Incline your ear and come unto Me: hear and your soul shall live. And I will make an Everlasting Covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David."

sermons.title: Sermon 2093 | The Curse and the Curse for Us

scripture.verse: "For as many as are of the works of the Law are under the curse; for itis written, Cursed is everyone who does not continue in all things which are written in the book of the law, to do them. But that no one is justified by the Law in the sight of God is evident, for the just shall live by faith. Yet the law is not of faith, but, the man who does them shall live by them. Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us for itis written, Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree, that the blessing of Abraham might come upon the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith."
"And the king commanded and they brought great stones, costly stones and hewed atones, to lay the foundation of the house."
